data.title: ONE Championship: Freddie Haggerty targets Sam-A as he plots strawweight title route
data.description: Freddie Haggerty has set his sights on Thailand’s Sam-A Gaiyanghadao as he plots a route towards ONE Championship’s strawweight Muay Thai title – and says friendship would not stop him facing fellow Englishman Ellis Barboza.

data.title: Star coaches make their bows as Nations League returns
data.description: PARIS - The 2026/27 Nations League kicks off on Thursday but all eyes will be on the touchlines as a starry cast of new coaches, including Zinedine Zidane and Jurgen Klopp, prepare to make their debuts in international football.

data.title: Zidane gets down to work as France start new era
data.description: PARIS — Zinedine Zidane spent years patiently waiting in the wings for his chance to manage France and on Friday the successor to Didier Deschamps as coach of Les Bleus will lead the side out for the first time in a Uefa Nations League tie in Turkey.

data.title: Horses pass inspection, eventers ready
data.description: Thailand's national eventing team are ready to begin their campaign at the 20th Asian Games after all four horses successfully passed the official horse inspection on Sunday.

data.title: Asean Cup: Stars report for training
data.description: Thailand's national team have reported for a training camp ahead of the Fifa Asean Cup 2026 in Indonesia, with head coach Anthony Hudson bringing together a squad built around senior figures.

data.title: Buriram go top as own goal sinks Sharks
data.description: Buriram United moved to the top of the Thai League 1 table on Sunday night, edging out hosts Chonburi 1-0 in a tense encounter at Chonburi Stadium.

data.title: Infantino proposes consulting federations to reform FIFA
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA president Gianni Infantino on Monday suggested a "consultation" with the member federations to reform the world football governing body's decision-making processes, in a letter addressed to the 211 member associations, and seen by AFP.

data.title: Schoolgirl Yu scorches to second gold as doping case rocks Asian Games
data.description: NAGOYA (JAPAN) - Schoolgirl swimmer Yu Zidi won her second gold of the Asian Games on Monday with the fastest time in the world this year, while a teenage badminton player became the first doping case.

data.title: Doping shock rocks Thailand camp at Asian Games
data.description: Badminton player Pitchamon Opatniputh has emerged as the first known doping case at the 20th Asian Games in Japan, after the 19-year-old rising star returned a positive test that has rocked Thailand's campaign in Aichi-Nagoya.

data.title: ONE Championship: Jonathan Haggerty welcomes Rodtang trilogy and Superlek rematch – ‘I’m ready for it all’
data.description: Jonathan Haggerty has opened the door to a trilogy fight with Rodtang Jitmuangnon and another meeting with Superlek Kiatmoo9 – the two rivals responsible for his only defeats in ONE Championship.

data.title: China's Yu, 13, great for swimming says multiple Olympic medallist
data.description: TOKYO - China's 13-year-old sensation Yu Zidi is "exciting for the swimming world" and part of the sport's trend towards younger athletes, Hong Kong's multiple Olympic medallist Siobhan Haughey said on Monday.

data.title: Man City outgun Sunderland despite Brobbey hat-trick, Man Utd rescue Fulham draw
data.description: MANCHESTER - Manchester City went top of the Premier League despite Brian Brobbey's hat-trick in a 5-3 thriller on Sunday as Matheus Cunha rescued Manchester United from another damaging defeat at Fulham.

data.title: Ice-cool Pavit does it after 7 long years
data.description: Linkou: Pavit Tangkamolprasert holed a nerve-jangling four-foot birdie putt on the final hole to hold off defending champion Kazuki Higa and complete a memorable wire-to-wire victory at the Yeangder TPC yesterday.

data.title: PT Prachuap cruise to easy away victory over Pattani
data.description: PT Prachuap eased to a comfortable 3-0 victory over Pattani in the Thai League 1 at Tinsulanonda Stadium on Saturday night, with goals in each half securing all three points for the visitors.

data.title: PSG president Nasser al-Khelaifi under investigation in France for conflict of interest
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Nasser al-Khelaifi, the Qatari president of French football club Paris Saint-Germain (PSG), is under investigation in France on suspicion of an illegal conflict of interest, prosecutors in Paris said on Sunday.

data.title: Golden triple as Thais rule the table in Japan
data.description: Thailand’s teqball stars struck gold three times over in Nagoya on Sunday, sweeping the mixed, women’s and men’s doubles titles to announce themselves as the team to beat on the sport’s Asian Games debut.

data.title: Five-goal blitz secures Thailand's place in football quarters
data.description: Thailand put on a five-star show in Nagoya on Sunday, thrashing Hong Kong 5-1 to sail into the quarter-finals of the men's football event at the 20th Asian Games, with a second-half goal blitz putting the tie beyond doubt.

data.title: Former ⁠England ⁠forward Townsend hit by pitch roller while warming up in Thai league
data.description: Former ⁠England ⁠forward Andros Townsend ​was nearly run over by ​a motorised ‌pitch roller while warming up with his Prachuap teammates at half-time during a Thai League 1 match on ​Saturday.

data.title: Townsend hit by pitch roller while warming up in Thai league
data.description: Former ⁠England ⁠forward Andros Townsend ​was nearly run over by ​a motorised ‌pitch roller while warming up with his Prachuap teammates at half-time during a Thai League 1 match on ​Saturday.

data.title: First Asian Games gold goes to Japan as China's 13-year-old Yu lights up pool
data.description: NAGOYA (JAPAN) - The first gold medal of the 20th Asian Games was won on Sunday by host nation Japan as a 13-year-old swimmer from China started in blistering form on the opening day of the multisports extravaganza.

data.title: Triple gold shots for Thai teqball doubles stars
data.description: Teqball stars will be bidding to win the gold medals for the Thai contingent after they reached the finals of the women's doubles, mixed doubles and men's doubles events on Saturday.

data.title: Davis strikes in injury time as Uthai Thani stun Ayutthaya
data.description: Benjamin Davis struck in injury time as Uthai Thani came from behind to win 2-1 at Ayutthaya United in the Thai League 1 on Friday night.

data.title: War Elephants eyeing last-8 spot with a victory over Hong Kong
data.description: Thailand target another three points as they take on Hong Kong in their second Group A match in the 20th Asian Games men's football tournament at Toyota Stadium in Japan on Sunday.

data.title: Five cheers for Kingdom's heroes as they celebrate golden wins
data.description: Thailand's national golf team brought home five titles at the Southeast Asian Amateur Golf Team Championships 2026 in Hong Kong on Friday.

data.title: The biggest sporting show begins
data.description: Nagoya: The 20th Asian Games were declared open by Japan's emperor on Saturday following a troubled build-up to the multi-sport spectacular that has more athletes than the Olympics.

data.title: Arsenal thrashed by Brighton, sorry Spurs lose again
data.description: LONDON - Arsenal's perfect start to their Premier League title defence came off the rails in a 3-0 trouncing by Brighton, while Tottenham remain winless after a 3-2 defeat to Aston Villa.

data.title: 'Fragile' Tottenham beaten by Aston Villa despite late rally
data.description: LONDON - The end to Tottenham's Premier League goal drought came too late as Aston Villa won 3-2 in north London on Saturday to compound a miserable start for Roberto De Zerbi's men.

data.title: Martin wins Austrian MotoGP sprint after Acosta crash
data.description: SPIELBERG (AUSTRIA) - Jorge Martin won Saturday's Austrian MotoGP sprint race to retake the championship lead from Marc Marquez, after Pedro Acosta crashed out with victory in sight.

data.title: ONE Championship: Kiamran Nabati tells Yod-IQ to ‘polish my belt’ after Nontachai win
data.description: Kiamran Nabati has put himself back in the ONE Championship bantamweight Muay Thai title conversation after rebounding with a unanimous decision over Nontachai Jitmuangnon at The Inner Circle 31.

data.title: Asian Games to open in Japan after troubled build-up
data.description: NAGOYA, Japan - The 20th Asian Games will open in Japan later Saturday with a glittering ceremony following a stuttering build-up to a multi-sport spectacular that has more participants than the Olympics.

data.title: Crunch time for Spurs and Villa, Dockyard Derby back
data.description: There is a huge match at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium today with a clash between two big Premier League teams that had been strongly tipped for European places but currently find themselves struggling near the foot of the table.

data.title: Kingdom's stars chase redemption on two wheels in Nagoya
data.description: Four years ago in Hangzhou, Thailand's best hope for cycling gold lost it in the final metres -- beaten to the line by a Japanese rider on Chinese soil. Now the rematch comes full circle: the 20th Asian Games are being held in Japan itself, and Thailand's cycling team has arrived determined not to let history repeat.

data.title: Thais target bigger haul than Hangzhou
data.description: Thailand's 694-member team -- a blend of Olympic medallists, world champions, former winners and a host of first-timers -- will head into the Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 aiming to put on a better show than they did in Hangzhou, China, three years ago.

data.title: Kwanchanok and Miguel are Thailand Amateur Open champs
data.description: Kwanchanok Boonchan and Ilas Miguel won the 92nd Singha Thailand Amateur Open 2026 after yesterday's final round at Panya Indra Golf Club was cancelled because of heavy rain.

data.title: Thai spikers, teqball aces seal progress
data.description: The Thai women's volleyball team swept aside Taiwan 3-0 to cruise into the quarter-finals as Pool C winners, capping off a dominant run through the preliminary phase at the Okazaki Chuo Sogo Park Gymnasium in Okazaki City, Aichi Prefecture, on Friday.

data.title: BG Pathum fight back to hold Sailors
data.description: BG Pathum United fought back to secure a 1-1 draw against Singapore's Lion City Sailors in their AFC Champions League Two Group F fixture on Thursday.

data.title: Australian athlete who soiled herself apologises for continuing Hyrox race
data.description: SYDNEY - An Australian athlete who sparked an outcry when she kept competing despite soiling herself midway through an event in Beijing apologised Friday and forfeited her points from winning.

data.title: Juventus, Palace cruise to Europa League wins, Bournemouth beat Sociedad
data.description: LONDON - Juventus began their quest for Europa League glory with a 5-0 thrashing of NEC Nijmegen, while Bournemouth secured an impressive victory at Real Sociedad on their European debut on Thursday.

data.title: Man Utd misery puts Carrick under pressure, Spurs feeling the heat
data.description: LONDON - Michael Carrick needs a win at Fulham to ease the mounting pressure on troubled Manchester United while Tottenham are desperate for their first Premier League goal of the season against fellow strugglers Aston Villa.
